description: 应用 RED 主视图：以应用为单位（发布策略拆出的 -canary/-preview Svc 自动聚合），一条线到底：应用总览 → 错误专项 → Pod 维度 → 连接池与依赖分解。

panels.title: ① 应用 RED 总览

panels.description: 应用整体每秒请求数，按 Svc 堆叠——发布策略拆出的 -canary/-preview 等 Svc 的流量切分一眼可见。

targets.expr: sum by (destination_service_name)(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "destination_service_name", "无流量", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: 应用 QPS（按 Svc 堆叠）

panels.description: 各 Svc 的 5xx 请求速率——canary 出错时立刻定位是哪个 Svc。

targets.expr: sum by (destination_service_name)(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app", response_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "destination_service_name", "无错误", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: 应用 5xx 速率（按 Svc）

panels.description: 应用整体延迟，跨所有 Svc 聚合；虚线为 15 分钟前 P99 基线，用于故障注入前后对照。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le)(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval]))) or vector(0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le)(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval]))) or vector(0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le)(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval]))) or vector(0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le)(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: 应用延迟 P50/P95/P99

panels.description: 各 Svc 的 2xx 成功率（分母 clamp_min 防除零）。

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (destination_service_name)(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app", response_code=~"2.."}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (destination_service_name)(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.001) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "destination_service_name", "无流量", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: 应用成功率 2xx（按 Svc）

panels.description: 应用维度各 HTTP 状态码的请求速率分布，看哪一类 5xx 占主导。

targets.expr: sum by (response_code)(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "response_code", "无请求", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: 状态码分布

panels.description: 所有异常响应标记（排除正常的"-"）。FI=故障注入abort，DI=故障注入delay，UO=连接池/队列满被拒，UF=上游连接失败，UH=无健康上游，URX=重试耗尽，RL=限流，DC=下游连接中断；组合值如"URX,UF"表示多重原因叠加。

targets.expr: sum by (response_flags)(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app", response_flags!="-"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "response_flags", "无异常", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: 异常响应标记（response_flags）

panels.description: 当前时间窗口内因连接池/排队队列溢出（UO）被拒绝的请求总数，大于 0 说明熔断或连接池已触发（无事件时显示 0 而非 No data）。

targets.expr: sum(increase(istio_requests_total{response_flags="UO", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: 连接池溢出计数（UO）

panels.description: 本应用视角下，调用各下游产生的 5xx 错误速率 TOP10（调用方上报，包含半路失败的请求）。

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (destination_service_name)(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="source", source_app="$app", response_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 本应用调下游 5xx TOP10
③ Pod 维度（选应用即自动列出全部 Pod）

panels.description: 该应用每个 Pod 一条曲线，灰度新旧 Pod 的流量切分一眼可见。

targets.expr: sum by (pod)(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "pod", "无流量", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Pod QPS（每 Pod 一条曲线）

panels.description: 每个 Pod 的 5xx 请求速率，定位错误来自哪个 Pod 实例。

targets.expr: sum by (pod)(rate(istio_requests_total{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app", response_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "pod", "无错误", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Pod 5xx 速率

panels.description: 每个 Pod 一条 P99 曲线，定位慢 Pod（按你的要求与 P50 拆成两个图，避免线条挤在一起）。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, pod)(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "pod", "无数据", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Pod P99 延迟

panels.description: 每个 Pod 一条 P50（中位）延迟曲线。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, pod)(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "pod", "无数据", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Pod P50 延迟

panels.description: 每个 Pod 的 CPU 使用核数（kubelet 视角，与 Istio 无关）。

targets.expr: sum by (pod)(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "pod", "无数据", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Pod CPU（核）
④ 连接池与依赖分解

panels.description: 本应用所有 Pod 作为调用方，到各下游服务的出站活跃连接数与活跃请求数；两者之差≈空闲连接（HTTP/2 下为近似值）。

targets.expr: sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_active{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无连接", "__name__", ".*")

sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_active{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无请求", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: 连接池：活跃连接 vs 活跃请求（出站）

panels.description: 出站排队深度与溢出速率：排队溢出/连接池溢出 >0 即连接池或队列已满，是熔断触发点。

targets.expr: sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_pending_active{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无排队", "__name__", ".*")

sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_pending_overflow{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}[$__rate_interval])), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无溢出", "__name__", ".*")

sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_pool_overflow{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}[$__rate_interval])), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无溢出", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: 连接池：排队与溢出（出站）

panels.description: 出站建连失败/建连超时/带着活跃请求被销毁的速率，反映上游连接健康度。

targets.expr: sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_connect_fail{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}[$__rate_interval])), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无失败", "__name__", ".*")

sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_connect_timeout{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}[$__rate_interval])), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无超时", "__name__", ".*")

sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_destroy_local_with_active_rq{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}[$__rate_interval])), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无销毁", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: 连接池：失败/超时/销毁（出站）

panels.description: 出站熔断器实时状态（cx/rq/pending 三档，1=开路）。

targets.expr: sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(envoy_cluster_circuit_breakers_default_cx_open{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无熔断", "__name__", ".*")

sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(envoy_cluster_circuit_breakers_default_rq_open{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无熔断", "__name__", ".*")

sum by (svc)(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (cluster_name)(envoy_cluster_circuit_breakers_default_rq_pending_open{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$app.*", cluster_name=~"outbound[|]9080[|].*"}), "svc", "$1", "cluster_name", "outbound[|]9080[|][^|]*[|]([^.]*)[.].*"), "svc", "$1", "svc", "^(.*)-(canary|preview|v[0-9]+)$")) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "svc", "无熔断", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: 连接池：熔断器状态（出站）

panels.description: 本应用视角下，每个下游服务的调用延迟 P99。应用延迟高时先看这里：某下游 P99 高 → 瓶颈在下游；所有下游正常 → 慢在自身代码。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, destination_service_name)(rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{reporter="source", source_app="$app"}[$__rate_interval]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "destination_service_name", "无下游", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: 本应用调用各下游 P99

options.content:
### 纯自身处理时间说明

sidecar 延迟（reporter=destination）包含本服务调用下游的耗时。若要“排除下游的纯自身处理时间”，需通过分布式追踪（Jaeger/Tempo）查看 span self-time，或对业务方法埋点。

**判断逻辑**：应用延迟高 → 看“本应用调用各下游 P99” → 某下游高则切到该应用继续看；所有下游正常则慢在自身代码。

title: 应用 RED 主视图
